title: Book Three · Chapter 67: More Than One City
story:
The next week, Anna brings a borrowed book to lunch.

Its cover shows a building with a wide roof. Inside are rooms, drawings, and people at long tables.

Ronan opens his lunch box beside it.

“Another window?”

“Architecture,” she says. She points to the word above the first picture. “The design of buildings.”

He reads the word slowly. Then he looks at the tables.

“Students?”

“Some of them. They learn to draw plans and work with space. I want to learn that.”

“After school?”

“Later. After this part of school. I need maths now, and more drawing practice.”

She turns a page. A room fills the whole picture. Small models stand on the tables.

Ronan studies one model. Its roof lifts away from the walls.

“I can understand that part.”

Anna smiles. “You can see the rooms.”

Lin comes over with her lunch. She looks at the open page and asks which city is in the picture.

Anna points to the name below it. It is not their city, and it is not Leo's.

“You want to go there?” Ronan asks.

“Maybe there. Maybe another place. I want to study in another city one day.”

He keeps his hand on the lunch box lid.

“There are good buildings here.”

“I know. I like them too. I want to see other ones and learn more.”

She says it easily. Ronan only planned a short visit to Leo. Anna is talking about years of study.

Lin asks about the models. Anna turns another page and shows her a room with no roof at all.

Ronan takes a bite of rice. He looks at the two girls, then at the new city name.

“It looks far,” he says.

Anna nods. “It is. I don't know the costs yet. I am only looking now.”

She puts a small piece of paper beside the page. There are two words on it: maths and drawing.

Ronan finishes his lunch more quietly than usual.

At the end, Anna closes the book and looks at his empty box.

“Outside?”

“For a little while.”

They go downstairs with Lin. Kai is on the grass with the ball. He calls to Ronan, who catches the first throw against his coat.

Anna and Lin walk toward the track. Before they turn, Anna looks back and lifts a hand.

Ronan lifts his own. Then he sends the ball across to Kai and follows the boys onto the grass.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

architecture＝建筑设计、建筑学；model＝模型；cost＝费用；more quietly than usual＝比平常更安静地。

## 理解问题

1. Anna想继续学什么？她想去的是否已经是确定录取的学校或城市？
2. Ronan为什么变得安静？他原来想象的外地旅行和Anna说的未来有何不同？

## 读句子

**I want to study in another city one day.**

拆开看：I / want to study / in another city / one day.

我／想去学习／在另一个城市／在将来的某一天。
